structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience

discovery-weak-signals.name: enterprise agentic-AI adoption

discovery-weak-signals.name: asset monetization model

adversarial-red-team.name: confidence inflation

adversarial-red-team.name: source dependence
adversarial-red-team.basis: Current Beta lineage is company-primary; the named counterparties and financing structure are concrete, but independent outcome evidence remains limited.

expectations-execution.name: platform-to-workflow conversion
expectations-execution.basis: Bunsen is moving into a named large-pharma research organization.

expectations-execution.name: capital efficiency
expectations-execution.basis: External Series A capital supports contributed programs while Schrödinger retains contingent economics.
